IIT JAM 2027 Online Form - Complete Details

IIT JAM 2027 Online Form. Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website before the last date. The last date to apply is 12/10/2026. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Important Dates

  • Start Date : 12/09/2026
  • Last Date : 12/10/2026
  • Last Date for Fee Payment : 12/10/2026
  • Exam City Available Date : As Per Schedule
  • Admit Card Released Date : As Per Schedule
  • Exam Date : 14 February 2027
  • Result Declared Date : 18/03/2027

Application Fee

  • Start Date : 12/09/2026
  • Last Date : 12/10/2026
  • Last Date for Fee Payment : 12/10/2026
  • General / OBC / EWS : Rs. 1800/- for Single Paper
  • SC / ST / PH / Female : Rs. 900/- for Single Paper
  • General / OBC / EWS : Rs. 2500/- for Double Paper
  • SC / ST / PH / Female : Rs. 1250/- for Double Paper
  • JAM 2027 Photo Instruction : Face Should Occupy at Least 75% of Photograph Good Quality Latest Passport Size Color Photo  with White Background.
  • Instruction of Signature : Draw Rectangular Box 2 Cm X 7 CM on  A4 Size Paper, Sign Within Draw Box on Black / Blue Pen in Running Hand.
  • Instruction of Thumb Impression : Draw Rectangular Box 3 cm X 5 Cm on A4 Size, Mark Your Left Thumb Impression within Draw Box
  • Joint Admission Test for Masters (JAM) : Indian Institute of Technology IIT Kharagpur

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
